title: A topological proof that compact Hausdorff spaces are not finitely co-concrete
summary: Lieberman, Rosický, and Vasey proved that $\mathbf{CompHaus}^{\mathrm{op}}$ - the opposite of the category of compact Hausdorff spaces - is not finitely concrete by a route through Hilbert and Banach spaces, commutative unital $C^*$-algebras, and Gelfand duality. We give a short topological proof. Moreover, we strengthen the result by identifying a specific sequential colimit in $\mathbf{CompHaus}^{\mathrm{op}}$ that no faithful set-valued functor preserves.
